result.topic_en: Gauss records the corrected result for an elliptic-integral transformation using theta-type series a and b in powers of μ, gives the power-series relation between t and T, and derives an infinite-product expression for t in terms of T.
result.transcription:
226
Das berichtigte Resultat in einfachster Form ist $\mu\mu = \lambda$
$1 + 2\mu^4 + 2\mu^{16} + 2\mu^{36} + \ldots = a$
$2\mu + 2\mu^9 + 2\mu^{25} + \ldots = b$
$\int \frac{dt}{\sqrt{(aa-bbtt)}\cdot\sqrt{(bb-aatt)}} = \frac{dT}{\sqrt{(4\mu\mu - TT)}}$
also
$t + \frac{1}{6}\left(\frac{bb}{aa}+\frac{aa}{bb}\right)t^3 + \left(\frac{3}{40}\cdot\frac{b^4}{a^4} + \frac{1}{20} + \frac{3}{40}\frac{a^4}{b^4}\right)t^5 + \ldots$
$= \frac{ab}{2\mu}\left\{T + \frac{1}{24\mu\mu}T^3 + \frac{3}{640\mu^4}T^5 + \ldots\right\}$
also erste Glieder
$T = \frac{2\mu}{ab}\left\{t + \frac{a^4+b^4-1}{6aabb}\cdot t^3 + \right.$
Auch wird aus dem S. 223 gegebenen Product=Ausdruck
wenn man zuerst $u = \mu x$ schreibt woraus
$x + \frac{1}{x} = \frac{T}{\mu}$
wird, leicht abgeleitet
$t = T\,\frac{(1-\mu^4)^2+\mu^6 TT}{(1-\mu\mu)^2+\mu\mu TT}\cdot\frac{(1-\mu^8)^2+\mu^{14}TT}{(1-\mu^6)^2+\mu^{10}TT}\cdot$ &c.
oder
$t = \left\{\frac{(1-\mu^4)(1-\mu^8)(1-\mu^{12})\ldots}{(1-\mu\mu)(1-\mu^6)(1-\mu^{10})\ldots}\right\}^2\cdot T\,\frac{1+\frac{\mu^6}{(1-\mu^4)^2}TT}{1+\frac{\mu\mu}{(1-\mu\mu)^2}TT}\cdot\frac{1+\frac{\mu^{14}}{(1-\mu^8)^2}TT}{1+\frac{\mu^{10}}{(1-\mu^6)^2}TT}\ldots$
und hieraus der allgemeine Ausdruck für $\log\frac{t}{T}$ vermittelst einer
nach geraden Potenzen von T steigenden Reihe

methods.what: Definition of theta-type series a and b in powers of μ (with μμ = λ)
Transformation of an elliptic differential into dT/sqrt(4μμ − TT)
Power-series expansion of both sides of the integral relation
Series inversion giving first terms of T in terms of t
Substitution u = μx in the product expression of p. 223
Infinite-product expression of t in terms of T
Equivalent normalized product form with constant factor
Series for log(t/T) in even powers of T from the product
